en.topic_title: Hong Kong man charged with voyeurism over hiding pinhole cameras in gym
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong man has been charged with voyeurism after he was arrested for allegedly installing hidden pinhole cameras in a gym changing room.



Shatin Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. 



Fung Kwok-wang, a 34-year-old worksite foreman, left the Shatin Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday morning after being granted bail.



A pinhole camera found at a 24/7 Fitness Shatin. Photo: @4_matthew_15 via Threads screenshot.



He was arrested on Sunday, after videos of a pinhole camera taped
